Partner With Tecqmate

Put your product in front of people who are actively searching for step-by-step answers: developers, businesses comparing providers, and buyers researching a purchase.

Readers With a Task

Our guides answer specific how-to questions, so readers arrive with a problem to solve or a decision to make. Topics include DevOps and APIs, messaging and telecom, trade, and business services.

Search-Led Discovery

Content is written for long-tail search queries, which aims to bring your product to people who are already evaluating tools and providers. We do not guarantee rankings or traffic numbers.

Flexible Models

Choose a flat-fee sponsored guide, an affiliate placement, a tool listing, or performance-based lead referrals, depending on your goal.

Partnership Opportunities

Partnership offerings, descriptions, and best-fit products
Offering Description Best For
Sponsored Guide A dedicated 1,500+ word tutorial or buyer's guide that features your product naturally within the workflow. Clearly labeled as sponsored. SDKs, APIs, developer tools, cloud services
Affiliate Integration Contextual product placement with tracking links inside relevant guides and tools. Links are marked rel="sponsored". Hosting, SaaS, payment gateways
Qualified Lead Referrals Readers describe their requirement in an on-site form. With their consent, we pass relevant enquiries to you. Commission or per-lead terms are agreed in writing. CPaaS and messaging, staffing and HRMS, exporters, tenders services, furniture, education
Tool Directory Listing A listing in our tools or resources directory, marked as sponsored. DevOps utilities, API services

Our Sponsorship Standards

  • Sponsored content is labeled "Sponsored" and commercial links use rel="sponsored".
  • Sponsors do not control our technical conclusions. We may decline or edit a draft that is inaccurate or misleading.
  • We do not accept promotions for gambling, adult content, unregistered investment advice or trading tips, or products with unverifiable health or income claims.
  • Read how we describe our content and its limits in our disclaimer.
